tasks.title: Write Jinshu’s intro
tasks.note: Human-authored introductions are the main blocker for the 22 unpublished books. Publishing more volumes is a potential KDP revenue opportunity. AI translation is acceptable; AI must not write the introductions. Jinshu still needs its reviewed glossary and final ebook QA before release.

tasks.title: Investigate remaining NPC/chart reports
tasks.note: The captured player bank-turn failures are fixed and Steam promotion is confirmed. Remaining chart reframe and NPC stuck-route reports are separate investigations. Compare fresh-build incidents before choosing more changes; old-build warnings do not establish a regression.
tasks.signal: Player turns fixed; NPC/chart cases remain.
tasks.outcome: Remaining incidents classified by build and a focused reproduction plan recorded.

tasks.title: Reproduce Linux controller failure
tasks.note: The reproduced cannon crew-starvation behavior is fixed; canonical Q/E and controller firing passed on the short-crewed galleass. The original input snapshot and Linux Steam Controller hardware failure remain unverified. Reproduce that hardware path before changing bindings.

tasks.title: Lock the Supporter Pack scope
tasks.note: Confirm final contents, price and Steam DLC review readiness for November 18. The packaged local globe prototype has passed reported local QA; Steam delivery remains open. US$6.99 is unapproved; audio files are excluded.
tasks.outcome: Contents, price and remaining launch dependencies recorded.

tasks.title: Write Jinshu’s opening
tasks.note: One session writing the opening in your own voice. Full introduction/review: roughly 4–8 hours; glossary and ebook QA follow.
tasks.signal: A small step toward book five.

tasks.title: Bank-side turns freed
tasks.note: Reproduced river/coastal galleass and xebec turns complete without backup relocation. Built-artifact replays passed at 30/60/240 Hz. Included in the promoted Steam reliability update and live itch release.

tasks.title: Release builds verified
tasks.note: The release record reports 9,482 Node tests, 1,122 localized layout views, 93 desktop-host checks and three independent packaged launches per edition passing. The matching Windows, Linux and macOS full/demo packages are uploaded and Steam promotion was confirmed by the owner.

events.title: First-week review
